description_en: Queries the storage usage of a database instance for which Database Autonomy Service (DAS) Enterprise Edition V1 or V2 is enabled
description_zh: 调用GetDasProServiceUsage接口，查询数据库实例DAS企业版 V1或企业版 V2存储空间的使用情况
name: GetDasProServiceUsage

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the database instance.

This parameter is optional. The system can automatically obtain the account ID based on the value of InstanceId when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，即创建数据库实例的阿里云主账号ID。

非必填，输入目标数据库实例ID后，在调用API接口时，系统会自动获取用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

commodityInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the DAS Enterprise Edition instance

engine.description_en: The type of the database engine

expireTime.description_en: The point of time when DAS Enterprise Edition for the database instance expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
expireTime.description_zh: 数据库实例企业版到期时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

instanceAlias.description_en: The name of the database instance

ip.description_en: The endpoint of the database instance

isSpare.description_en:
Indicates whether DAS Enterprise Edition for the database instance has expired. Valid values:

true

false
isSpare.description_zh:
数据库实例的企业版是否过期：

true：过期。
false：未过期

migrationPredictRemainingTime.description_en:
The estimated remaining time for migrating the data generated by the SQL Explorer and Audit feature from the previous version to the new version. Unit: milliseconds.

This parameter is returned only when the SQL Explorer and Audit feature is migrated from the previous version to the new version
migrationPredictRemainingTime.description_zh:
旧版SQL洞察和审计迁移到新版的预计剩余时间，单位为毫秒。
<notice>仅当进行旧版SQL洞察和审计迁移到新版操作时，返回此参数。
</notice>

port.description_en: The port number that is used to connect to the database instance

region.description_en: The region in which the database instance resides
region.description_zh: 数据库实例所属的地域

sqlRetention.description_en: The storage duration of SQL Explorer data. Unit: days
sqlRetention.description_zh: SQL洞察数据存储时长，单位为天

startTime.description_en: The time when DAS Enterprise Edition was enabled for the database instance. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
startTime.description_zh: 开启企业版的时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

storageFreeQuotaInMB.description_en: The SQL Explorer storage space that is offered free-of-charge. Unit: MB
storageFreeQuotaInMB.description_zh: 赠送的SQL洞察数据存储空间，单位为MB

storageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of SQL Explorer of the database instance. Unit: bytes
storageUsed.description_zh: 数据库实例已使用的SQL洞察数据存储空间，单位为Byte

userId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the database instance
userId.description_zh: 用户ID，即创建数据库实例的阿里云主账号ID

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
